objective: Gate 8E. Con autorizacion explicita del usuario para entregas externas reales, auditar SQL real antes de habilitarlas. Cerrar origen canonico exacto de email/telefono por UsuarioObjetivoID, preferencias por canal, configuracion de notificaciones y columnas de log. No leer secretos ni valores sensibles completos. No DML/DDL, no envios, no Produccion. Esta auditoria prepara el Gate de implementacion real de EMAIL/WHATSAPP y determina si APP tiene infraestructura canonica suficiente o debe permanecer fail-closed.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: recipient_preference_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Usuario_Catalogo','Usuario_PortalConfiguracion','Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: recipient_preference_columns
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name IN ('Usuario_Catalogo','Usuario_PortalConfiguracion','Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: usuario_contact_shape
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 UsuarioID,CASE WHEN Email IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Email))='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS TieneEmail,CASE WHEN Celular IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Celular))='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS TieneCelular,CASE WHEN Telefono IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(Telefono))='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS TieneTelefono,Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo ORDER BY UsuarioID

queries.name: portal_preferences_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT RecibeEmailNotificaciones,RecibeWhatsAppNotificaciones,RecibePushNotificaciones,COUNT_BIG(*) AS cantidad FROM dbo.Usuario_PortalConfiguracion GROUP BY RecibeEmailNotificaciones,RecibeWhatsAppNotificaciones,RecibePushNotificaciones ORDER BY 1,2,3

queries.name: portal_preference_key_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Usuario_PortalConfiguracion') AND (c.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR c.name LIKE '%User%' OR c.name LIKE '%ID%') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: notification_log_shape_counts
queries.sql: SELECT Canal,Estado,COUNT_BIG(*) AS cantidad FROM dbo.Operativo_Notificaciones_Log GROUP BY Canal,Estado ORDER BY Canal,Estado

queries.name: app_push_objects_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Push%' OR o.name LIKE '%AppNotific%' OR o.name LIKE '%Device%' OR o.name LIKE '%Dispositivo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Token%Push%') ORDER BY o.name

constraints: Do not expose full emails or phone numbers in evidence
